swimming_pool.evidence: A turquoise kidney/rectangular-shaped in-ground pool with a paved deck sits directly beside the rear of the central gray-roofed house.

signals.notes: Central house has an in-ground pool at the rear right next to the patio, and a long concrete driveway to the north with a white vehicle parked; a separate above-ground pool is on the neighboring lot at lower left, not this lot.
